summary: Leading eigenpairs of the steady cubic cavity flow at Re = 1914. The leading pair is slightly stable: sigma = -1.83e-4, omega = 0.5868.
description: Direct stability (mode 3.1) about the steady flow of 210_baseflow_newton/fp at Re = 1914, uniform lid. The leading pair has a growth rate just below zero, so the flow is stable but close to the first Hopf bifurcation (Re = 1916.63). The expected values are those of the run named under produced, not literature values. The frequency of the leading pair agrees with St = 0.0934 of the thesis (Table 4.1): 2 pi St = 0.5869. The runs on 16 and on 40 ranks agree to 1e-8 on sigma and 1e-7 on omega, so the tolerance of 2e-6 on sigma is 200 times the spread between runs. It still fails the leading pair of the same flow at Re = 1920 (sigma = +5.84e-4, omega = 0.58679, cubic_cavity_re1920/310_stability_direct) and any run at a Reynolds number that is wrong by more than 0.02 (d sigma / d Re = 1.3e-4 per unit of Re). The second pair is stable, sigma = -0.0205, omega = 0.5609; it checks that the leading pair is the only one near the imaginary axis.

leading_sigma.note: Growth rate of the leading pair (negative: stable).

second_sigma.note: Growth rate of the second pair (third row of the file): stable.
